item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.5

  • Dedicated Volume Chart Card: Detailed trading volume analysis with discrete session-based 1D, 1W, and 1M views, eliminating weekend gaps and overlaying a consistent, pre-warmed MA20 volume trendline.
  • 50D and 50W Volume Table Sparklines: Added 50D Vol (50 trading sessions with MA50) and 50W Vol (50 weeks with MA50W) column options to both Portfolio and Watchlist tables, with smooth amber moving average curves overlaid directly on volume bars.
  • Optimized Table Margins: Added dedicated right margin padding to portfolio and watchlist tables, perfectly aligning headers with row cells and ensuring full visibility without card border crowding.
